decisions.detail: Preserve documented motor v1 vocabulary and add separately typed fictional SIM-GROUP/RequestGroupQuote extensions for approved aggregate census count; no health PII or real tariffs.
Insurer-confirmed issuance persists before independent document retrieval; private UUID.pdf files use OBJECT_STORAGE_DIR and no public file server.

limitations: No actual insurer/payment authority or live credentials used.
No OAuth or real mTLS handler is claimed.
No reserve, endorsement, cancellation, claim or payout carrier operation is implemented.
Shared multi-replica quotas, comprehensive tracing/health alerts and full bulk report isolation need further qualification.
No production or representative200rps/1m-policy performance claim.
